verdict.rationale: incident.io ships built-in AI agents. Investigations does "the legwork a responder normally would" through a structured hypothesis-testing process. The changelog says users can "update your status page using the agent". Suggestions and post-mortem AI draft updates, summaries, follow-ups and post-mortems. missing for 10: documentation of the breadth of tasks users can hand to the agent directly (most evidence covers automatic investigation rather than user-initiated delegation), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Investigations automatically work out what's going on during an incident, doing the legwork a responder normally would, faster and across every source at once.
You can now update your status page using the agent
Suggestions uses AI to help teams communicate better during incidents by automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions based on your incident activity.
Generate first drafts, get inline review suggestions, and redraft sections with AI.
